newsitem.title: USA: Two firms win San Francisco, Calif., $60 mln TRANs.
newsitem.headline: Two firms win San Francisco, Calif., $60 mln TRANs.

text.p: Two firms won portions of a $60 million San Francisco, Calif., tax and revenue anticipation note issue on Wednedsay.
Citicorp won $40 million of the note issue with a true interest cost (TIC) of 3.769 percent and a coupon of 4.50 percent.
Zions First Nationl Bank won a $10 million portion with a TIC of 3.734 percent and a coupon of 4.50 percent and another $10 million portion with a TIC of 3.764 percent with a 4.50 percent coupon.
